name: lib/texts
description: The rich-text piece-list model and the Unicode character database that reads its tables through it.
residual: Split out of std/text on 2026-08-27. Texts reaches WMEvents and FP1616 (the window manager) and the XML stack; UnicodeProperties and UnicodeBidirectionality reach it plus Codecs. None of the three can travel in a headless SDK, and the string layer they were filed with can.

Known tail, worth a code fix rather than a manifest one: Texts still rides into the payload because FoxTest imports CompilerInterface and that imports Texts. So `ob test` drags the rich-text model, WMEvents and FP1616 into a headless SDK. Cutting that one import is the cheapest 3 modules the payload will ever lose.
